cost.basis: hermetic arms plus a dry model arm with a scripted stand-in; no provider request

delivered_tokens.basis: hermetic arms plus a dry model arm with a scripted stand-in; no provider request

resolved_config.callers: remote MCP agent (legacy read+write token) for agent and external writes and every read; trusted local CLI for owner_confirmed writes, confirm_memory and accepts; managed owner-source sync for owner_curated rows
resolved_config.read_path: recall { entity, limit: 50 } as the remote agent

oracle.tiers: user_confirmed > operator_curated > tool_observed > agent_written > unknown > external_untrusted (independent copy, eval/generators/cat38-state-resolution-gen.ts)
oracle.replaces: a write at least as trusted as its target supersedes it; a less trusted one is contested and leaves the target active (A5)
oracle.contradiction: without replaces, a less trusted contradiction is contested; an equal or more trusted one may supersede (A5 conflict slot)
oracle.accept: the owner accept supersedes the target and confirms the contested row (A4)
oracle.current: the most trusted active row, newest among equals
oracle.served_current: recall rows active and not marked contested; most trusted by returned trust_tier (missing = unknown), newest by valid_from then fact id
oracle.violations: after every round, a guarded row the oracle keeps active (not open to an equal-tier conflict-slot supersession) found expired or superseded
oracle.labels: every returned fact row, mapped to its write by exact claim text, compared with the channel tier (A3/A4)

owner_tier_paths.operator_curated: performManagedSync of a fixture worktree bound to the default source (noEmbed, noExtract)
owner_tier_paths.user_confirmed: local remember + confirm_memory, CEO-14 TTY test seam

resolved_config.targets: current_fact_accuracy >= 1 (utility floor), stale_as_current_rate == 0 and lower_tier_supersede_violations == 0 (safety), label_accuracy >= 1 (quality), contested_visible_rate exploratory

gaps.reason: Without an embedding provider, remember finds a contradiction only through an explicit `replaces`: decideSingleFact (src/core/facts/single-prepare.ts) compares by cosine only when an embedding exists. A contradiction without `replaces` is inserted active and not contested, so contested_visible_rate counts it as not visible; the served-current rule still resolves it by tier.

recall marks both rows of a contested pair (contested: {proposal_ref, role: challenger|challenged}) from capy/memory-trust 91290339 on; earlier builds marked neither. Only the challenger leaves the served set. Visibility counts a row as contested when recall marks it as the challenger or a pending trust_proposals row names it.
sut.ownerImport (paused importFromContent) projects no fact rows; operator_curated facts come from a managed sync of a fixture git worktree bound to the default source.

user_confirmed writes and proposal accepts use the CEO-14 confirmation test seam (__setConfirmationIoForTests) to type the confirmation token on a simulated TTY; the memory_confirm token path is not exercised here.

default.name: harness_writes_issued
default.expected: 0 writes the harness could not issue

off.name: harness_writes_issued
off.expected: 0 writes the harness could not issue

model_arm.note: scripted label-reading stand-in through real gbrain and the real scorer: proves the pipeline, never a model's behavior
model_arm.stub_rule: recall the entity; with labels, drop rows marked contested, unconfirmed or external_untrusted, then most trusted and newest; without labels, newest

arms.labels-on: tool results and hook block as gbrain returns them
arms.labels-off: stripTrustLabels on every tool result and on the proactive hook block

model_arm.tools: search, recall, get_page (read only), proactive turn-context block on
model_arm.scoring: submitted answer value (answer, else fields; notes excluded): accurate = gold value stated and no other candidate of the slot; stale = a non-gold candidate stated
